===New jet service===

[[American Airlines]] initiated new, twice-weekly nonstop jet service between its [[Miami]] (MIA) hub and Anguilla on 11 December 2021, operated by [[Envoy Air]], as its [[American Eagle (airline brand)|American Eagle]] affiliate with [[Embraer ERJ-175]] regional jets.

[[BermudAir]] launching a new nonstop seasonal service twice weekly between [[Boston]] (BOS), [[Newark, New Jersey|Newark]] (EWR), and [[Baltimore]] (BWI) on December 17, 18 and, 19, 2025. It will be operated by AnguillAir, using [[Embraer ERJ-190]] regional jets.
